```yaml
name: PR Commit Security Scan

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed]

jobs:
  scan:
    if: github.event.pull_request.merged == false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Brin CLI
        run: npm install -g brin

      - name: Run Brin scan on PR commits
        id: brin
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          REPO=${{ github.repository }}

          # Install jq
          sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

          # Get list of commit SHAs in the PR
          COMMITS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/commits" | jq -r '.[].sha')

          BLOCKING=()
          REVIEW=()
          INCONCLUSIVE=()
          CLEAN=1
          FAIL=0

          COMMENT_FILE=$(mktemp)
          echo "# Brin Security Scan Results" > "$COMMENT_FILE"
          echo "" >> "$COMMENT_FILE"

          for SHA in $COMMITS; do
            echo "Checking commit $SHA" >> "$COMMENT_FILE"
            git checkout "$SHA" --quiet

            # Run Brin scan and capture JSON output
            RESULT=$(brin scan --output json 2>&1 || true)
            SCORE=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.score // empty')
            STATUS=$(echo "$RESULT" | jq -r '.status // empty')

            # Default score to 0 if missing
            if [[ -z "$SCORE" ]]; then
              SCORE=0
            fi

            # Treat low score as dangerous
            if (( SCORE < 30 )); then
              STATUS="dangerous"
            fi

            case "$STATUS" in
              dangerous)
                BLOCKING+=("$SHA")
                FAIL=1
                CLEAN=0
                ;;
              review)
                REVIEW+=("$SHA")
                CLEAN=0
                ;;
              inconclusive)
                INCONCLUSIVE+=("$SHA")
                CLEAN=0
                ;;
              *)
                CLEAN=0
                ;;
            esac

            echo "Commit: $SHA" >> "$COMMENT_FILE"
            echo "Score: $SCORE" >> "$COMMENT_FILE"
            echo "Status: $STATUS" >> "$COMMENT_FILE"
            echo "" >> "$COMMENT_FILE"
          done

          echo "## Summary" >> "$COMMENT_FILE"
          echo "" >> "$COMMENT_FILE"
          echo "- Blocking: ${#BLOCKING[@]}" >> "$COMMENT_FILE"
          echo "- Review: ${#REVIEW[@]}" >> "$COMMENT_FILE"
          echo "- Inconclusive: ${#INCONCLUSIVE[@]}" >> "$COMMENT_FILE"
          echo "" >> "$COMMENT_FILE"

          if [[ $CLEAN -eq 1 ]]; then
            echo "All commits are clean." > "$COMMENT_FILE"
          fi

          echo "comment_file=$COMMENT_FILE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "clean=$CLEAN" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "needs_fail=$FAIL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Comment on PR
        if: steps.brin.outputs.clean != '1'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message-path: ${{ steps.brin.outputs.comment_file }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          comment-tag: brin-security-scan
          mode: replace
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

      - name: Delete comment if PR is clean
        if: steps.brin.outputs.clean == '1'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          REPO=${{ github.repository }}
          TAG="brin-security-scan"

          # Find comment ID with the tag
          COMMENT_ID=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/issues/$PR_NUMBER/comments" | \
            jq -r ".[] | select(.body | contains(\"$TAG\")) | .id" | head -n 1)

          if [[ -n "$COMMENT_ID" ]]; then
            curl -s -X DELETE -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/issues/comments/$COMMENT_ID"
          fi

      - name: Fail job if dangerous or low score
        if: steps.brin.outputs.needs_fail == '1'
        run: exit 1
```
